sections.title: Digital Technology and Child Development
sections.description: Digital Technology and Child Development The term "digital natives" is used to refer to the generations of children that have grown up surrounded by technology, making them particularly adept at using digital devices and platforms. However, there is an ongoing debate about the impact of digital technology on children’s cognitive and social development. This course explores the effects of digital technology on various aspects of childhood development, providing a view of how technology shapes the modern developmental landscape.
